title: Millions lose access to benefits and pensions services after 'cyber incident'
description: The Department for Work and Pensions says some of its services were taken offline as a precaution.

title: Catherine's emotional cancer documentary strips away the stiff upper lip
description: The Princess of Wales has made a documentary, Heal, describing her cancer experience in her own words.

title: 'Calculating predator' who blackmailed girls into self-harm jailed for 14 and a half years
description: Beau-Jack Mensforth is jailed for preying on nine girls, the youngest aged 12, across the world.

title: Set time aside for children to read for pleasure, schools to be told
description: The government says its new cirriculum hopes to reverse declining literacy rates and combat "mindless scrolling".

title: Spanish PM and rivals rally supporters in final pitch for votes
description: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez wants to defy the polls, and his main rivals accuse him of not telling the truth and of "betrayal".

title: Charity founded in Captain Tom's name bids to be struck off
description: The charity is now known as the 1189808 Foundation, having dropped the late fundraiser's name.

title: Weary of war but with no sign of backing down, Kyiv faces another punishing winter
description: Ukraine settles in for another devastating winter as the questions persists: how will it all end?

title: New satellite data shows how fast some African cities are sinking
description: Cities including Lagos and Alexandria are sinking faster than previously thought, a new study shows.

title: 'Poison seller' Kenneth Law apologises in court to the families of his victims
description: The Canadian man, who pleaded guilty to 14 counts of aiding and abetting suicide earlier this year, said he was remorseful for his actions.
